items.headline: Flood Watch issued November 2 at 7:04PM EST until November 2 at 11:00PM EST by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...A portion of southeast Florida, including the following
areas, Coastal Palm Beach County, Inland Palm Beach County and
Metro Palm Beach County.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM EST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Pockets of very heavy rainfall resulted in localized flash
flooding on Sunday and earlier today. Forecast amounts look very
similar to yesterday, with common amounts of 1 to 2 inches where
showers and storms occur. Scattered locations around South
Florida may see closer to 2 to 4 inches this evening.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued November 2 at 3:20PM EST until November 3 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor to Moderate coastal flooding, large breaking
waves of 6 to 7 feet in the surf zone, and dangerous rip
currents.

* WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County and Coastal Broward County.

* WHEN...Through Tuesday for the Coastal Flood Advisory and High
Rip Current Risk, and through this morning for the High Surf
Advisory.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Dangerous swimming and
surfing conditions and localized beach erosion. Rip currents
can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into deeper
water.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 2 at 3:17PM EST until November 3 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 25 kt and seas 5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach
FL out 20 NM and Waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach
FL from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
